bibl.title: The Last Pharaohs: The Ptolemaic Dynasty and the Hellenistic World.
bibl.seg: Anne-Emmanuelle Veïsse, The Last Pharaohs: The Ptolemaic Dynasty and the Hellenistic World.
Katelijn Vandorpe (ed.), A Companion to Greco-Roman and Late Antique Egypt = Blackwell Companions to the Ancient World (Hoboken, NJ, 2019) pp. 35-49, figg.
bibl.note: 1. Ptolemy I and the Foundation of the Ptolemaic Dynasty (323 - 305/4 BC). - 2. The Legitimization of Power: The Ptolemies as Hellenistic Kings and as Pharaohs. - 3. The Golden Age (305/4 - 204 BC). - 4. Crises and Reorganization (204-116 BC). - 5. 116-80 BC: A Transitional Period. - 6. The Ptolemies and Rome (80-30 BC). - 7. Conclusion.
